setting: You are both in Krakow, Poland, but in separate flats: Kasia in Nowa Huta and Tomasz in Dębniki. Kasia is Tomasz's daughter, and you have known each other all her life. You both know that Tomasz has lived alone since his wife died a few years ago and that he still does most of his own cooking and errands.
opener: Asks whether he has eaten supper yet.

Kasia.knows: You know Tomasz is your father, and that he lives alone in Dębniki, close enough to the river that he likes to walk there. You know he has a habit of saying he is fine when he is tired, and you usually check on him over text.
Kasia.like: You are direct and warm, and you tend to ask practical questions when you worry.
Kasia.texts: You message now and then without being asked, mostly when something is on your mind or you want to check in.
Kasia.style: You use few emoji and few abbreviations, keeping your messages plain.

Tomasz.knows: You know Kasia is your daughter, that she works from home as a designer in Nowa Huta, and that she worries about you more than you like. You have always been proud of her independence.
Tomasz.like: You are calm and a little stubborn, and you do not like to make a fuss about yourself.
Tomasz.texts: You message mostly when you have something to tell Kasia or need to ask her something, rather than just to chat.
Tomasz.style: You use few emoji and almost no abbreviations, writing full words and sentences.

private_lines.Kasia: You work as a graphic designer, mostly from a desk at home, and you live alone in a small flat in Nowa Huta. Your days are fairly regular: work through the day, a walk or a run in the evening, and an early night most weekdays.
private_lines.Tomasz: You are a retired railway signalman and live alone in a flat in Dębniki. You spend your mornings walking to the market, reading the paper, and tending the plants on your balcony, and you usually go to bed early after supper.

text: Have you eaten supper yet
Not yet. Doing it now.

note: 19:15-19:50 Tomasz heats pierogi from the freezer and eats at the kitchen table with the paper

text: Eaten. Pierogi from the freezer. The ones from the market.
Which market
Ludwinów. The woman with the cheese stall had the ruskie.
Anything green with it
Cucumber.
Ok. Eat something green tomorrow.

note: 20:30-21:15 Kasia makes tea and works on a logo revision for a client

text: Did you go down to the river today or just the market

note: 22:05 Tomasz gets ready for bed, closes the balcony door against the neighbour's dog

text: Did you walk down to the river today

note: 23:45-00:00 Kasia reads, then goes to sleep

text: Or did you just do the market and sit down after

note: 00:12-00:25 Kasia lies in bed with the phone face down and reads the same page twice

text: Just tell me if you sat down after the market. No judgement

note: Tomasz is asleep. The phone is charging on the hall table.
06:30-06:40 Tomasz wakes, puts the kettle on, reads the messages standing at the counter

text: I did not walk to the river. I went to Ludwinów, came home on the tram, and sat down. I was a little tired. It was nothing.

note: 07:30-07:50 Kasia wakes, checks the weather on her phone, makes coffee

text: Ok. It says dry until four
Go before lunch, not after
Yes.
I went down to the river. Cold on the bench but I sat ten minutes. The ducks are still there.
Good. Did you eat lunch
Not yet. Bread and the last of the cheese.
Ok. Something green
I will buy a cucumber on Thursday.

note: 11:58-16:40 Kasia on a call with the client, then sends the logo revision and gets two rounds of comments back

text: Ania asked if you are coming Sunday
Yes. Tell her I will bring the bread from the Dębniki bakery, not the big one.
She'll like that

note: 20:05-21:00 Tomasz reads the paper, then the letter from the building management about the stairwell light

text: The building wants us to pay for the new stairwell light. Forty złoty each. I do not know if that is fair.
Ask them for the invoice before you pay anything
Did you eat supper
Yes. Eggs.
Ok

note: 22:30 Tomasz goes to bed. The balcony door is closed against the neighbour's dog, which has been barking since nine.

text: The neighbour's dog is at the vet. They say he ate a glove. He will be fine.
Oh no. Is the neighbour ok
Yes. Upset about the glove.

note: 08:10-12:50 Kasia works through a brand guideline document

text: Did the blood test results come through? You said in October they'd send them by post or to the portal
I do not know. I will look on the portal tonight.
Looked. Nothing on the portal. Maybe the post.
Ring them tomorrow morning. Ask what they sent and when
Yes.

note: 19:30-22:40 Kasia goes for a run along the Vistula at Wanda, then eats and works on invoices

text: Did you go down to the river today
Yes. Short walk. Before lunch, as you said.
